title: Array length is part of array type
prompt: How does Rust treat two array types of different lengths, such as `[i32; 3]` and `[i32; 4]`?
answer: Array length is part of the array type in Rust. Arrays of different lengths are completely distinct types, so passing `[i32; 4]` where `[i32; 3]` is expected causes a compile-time type mismatch.
